answer.title: Automate Timesheet Reminders
answer.trigger: Every Friday at 13:30, check the payroll system for missing timesheets.
steps: Run a scheduled check in the payroll system to find staff with unsubmitted timesheets.
Draft a reminder email for each person who has not yet submitted their timesheet.
Send the reminder email automatically to the relevant staff members.
answer.ai_help: Drafting personalized reminder emails based on the missing dates from the payroll system.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, employees might receive an incorrect reminder to submit their timesheet.
